scope: Selected serial Fixed16 hardware probes. All arms retain the original image-complete cut. P continues locally and then performs a full P→D KV handoff. D continues locally. No online queueing, admission, steady traffic or Decode-protection conclusion.

interpretation.publication: First positive all-descriptor poll is an upper observation bound. A retirement before it may have followed true publication. A retirement before the last probe that actually saw a missing final descriptor is conservative proof for that run when the probe exists.
interpretation.early_before_ACK: Actual scheduler completion before E's full HTTP response. Includes host ACK latency.
interpretation.difference_in_differences: (late D − early D) − (late P − early P) per matched fixture and repeat. All comparisons include legitimate serial overhead. Raw P/D contrast also changes the full KV route.
interpretation.full_KV: P completion→D submit is host/orchestration gap. D submit→first token on P includes NIXL and native D processing. Individual NIXL DMA duration is outside this reduction.
interpretation.ipc_host: Prefix clone/sync uses measured serial recipient host intervals. These can include producer readiness waits, CUDA IPC mapping, clone enqueue, synchronization and CPU scheduling. They are not isolated memory copy or bandwidth measurements.
interpretation.E_event: Each successful producer CUDA event query contributes a readiness interval. All-image lower minus prefix upper bounds the lead from below. All-image upper minus prefix lower bounds it from above. Observed event diagnostics do not qualify profiler overhead.
interpretation.decode: Per-request ITL from emitted token timestamps. Serial trials cannot establish protection of another active Decode request. Request-level p99 is distinct from a pooled-token p99.
interpretation.repeat_strata: All completed quartets are primary. First and subsequent repeats are descriptive cold-start sensitivity and do not represent independent server starts.
